name: audio.stats
title: Audio stats (Mucavex analysis)
summary: Peak, RMS, crest, clipping, DC offset, stereo width, band energy, silence percentage and per-cycle loudness of an audio or video file.
description: Runs the vendored Mucavex analyzer over the first audio stream and returns its report unchanged: overall levels (peakDb, rmsDb, crestDb), clippedSamples, dcOffset, silencePct, stereoWidth, a low/mid/high band split, a per-cycle loudness breakdown (when a cycle rate is given) and human-readable warnings. Use it to catch silence, clipping, mud, harshness, a dead stereo field or a section that drops out. It measures; it never changes anything.

input.description: Audio or video file: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>. The first audio stream is analysed at 48 kHz stereo.

cps.description: Cycles per second used to break the report down per cycle. Give at most one of cps, bpm or window_s.

bpm.description: Tempo in beats per minute. Converted to cps as bpm / 60 / beats_per_cycle. Give at most one of cps, bpm or window_s.

beats_per_cycle.description: Beats per cycle when cps is derived from bpm (4 = one bar in 4/4). Ignored when bpm is absent.

window_s.description: Length of one analysis cycle in seconds; cps becomes 1 / window_s. Give at most one of cps, bpm or window_s.

examples.title: Per-cycle stats of a 120 BPM track
